title: 第9章 不拿是不是有点不尊重人家第10章 安排的明明白白
slug: 这个主角明明很强却异常谨慎
content_zh:
依照他的性格，百分之二百不会去窥探。
明知道事有蹊跷还去偷看，不是给自己找麻烦。
且万一是对方知道自己兜里怀有巨款，专门给自己设置的陷阱，就等自己上套后，抢走自己的妖丹怎么办。
但是。
这一次。
他仍旧遵循了自己的内心。
爱咋咋地。
跟我没有一毛钱关系。
一路上自己已赚了不少妖丹，知足者方能活的更久。
检查一遍陷阱，确认无误后。
郑拓一步都没有多走。
回到安全屋。
安安静静等候李俊等人杀上来，完成考核。
但……
你不去看那光亮，不代表其他人不会去看。
“嗷嗷……”
鸡头掰脸的狼啸从那一处发光地传来。
随后娇呵声响起。
有人在与狼王搏杀，听上去十分激烈。
“我就说吧，肯定有陷阱，落仙宗这群老东西都不是啥好鸟，幸亏哥谨慎，不然妖丹算是保不住了。”

郑拓更加坚信自己所走的路没有错。
“轰隆隆……”
发光处的战斗很激烈。
且正在逐渐靠近郑拓的安全屋。
郑拓皱眉。
什么鬼！
我不就是简单的吐槽一句，用不用把战斗引过来。
心里想着。
“踏踏……”
一道矫健的身影，宛若狸猫，稳稳落在郑拓头顶处。
这是一位少女，身材高挑，披肩长发火红，穿一身红羽战甲，手持一杆丈八火尖枪，英气逼人，宛若女战神般英姿飒爽。
而最让郑拓惊叹的是，小小年纪，竟已有两座金矿，可谓相当骇人。
特别是从郑拓这个角度望去。
我滴乖乖！
只能用一个词来形容，那就是圆润。
圆润少女眼似雷电，扫过周遭。
确认无人后，从怀中取出一枚巴掌大小的红色宝盒。
content_en:
According to his character, he would not pry 200% of the time.
If you know something fishy is going on but still take a peek, you are not causing trouble for yourself.
And what if the other party knows that he has a huge sum of money in his pocket and sets a trap specifically for himself, and then waits for him to fall into the trap and steals his demon pill.
but.
This time.
He still followed his heart.
Love so much.
It has nothing to do with me.
I have earned a lot of demon pills along the way, and only those who are satisfied can live longer.
Check the trap once and make sure it is correct.
Zheng Tuo didn't take another step.
Return to the safe house.
Quietly wait for Li Jun and others to come up and complete the assessment.
But...
Just because you don't look at the light doesn't mean that others won't look at it.
"Ouch..."
The howl of a wolf with a chicken's head breaking off its face came from that place.
Then a cooing sound sounded.
Someone is fighting the Wolf King, which sounds very fierce.
"Let me tell you, there must be a trap. These old guys from the Luo Xian Sect are not good birds. Fortunately, I am cautious, otherwise the demon pill will not be saved."
Zheng Tuo became even more convinced that the path he was taking was right.
"Rumble..."
The battle at the Glow is intense.
And is gradually approaching Zheng Tuo's safe house.
Zheng Tuo frowned.
What the hell!
I'm not just making a simple complaint to lead the fight.
I thought to myself.
"Tap..."
A vigorous figure, like a raccoon cat, landed steadily on Zheng Tuo's head.
This is a young girl with a tall figure, long shawl hair and fiery red hair. She wears a red-feathered battle armor and holds an eight-foot-long fire-pointed spear. She is as heroic as a goddess of war.
What amazed Zheng Tuo the most was that at such a young age, he actually had two gold mines, which was quite shocking.
Especially from Zheng Tuo's perspective.
I'm a good boy!
I can only use one word to describe it, that is mellow.
The round girl's eyes were like thunder and lightning, sweeping around her.
After confirming that no one was there, he took out a palm-sized red treasure box from his arms.
